page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.7xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a dedicated 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8163 processor providing 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The instance features a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation, configured with 128.0 GB of RAM (4.0 GB per vCPU). The underlying x86_64 architecture includes instruction set features such as AVX-512 foundation, AES-NI, and BMI2, paired with a 33 MB L3 cache.

Hardware provisioning does not include integrated local disk storage or GPU accelerators, necessitating network-attached block storage for persistent data. Network connectivity provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps. The server operates without complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which requires network address translation or detached Elastic IPs for external access.

Benchmark evaluations reveal modest single-thread capabilities, reflected in weak-tier scores for stress-ng single-core (1108.99), Geekbench single-core (967.0), and single-threaded gzip compression. However, the 32 dedicated vCPUs compensate during parallel execution. Multi-core performance reaches middle-tier levels across Geekbench multi-core (8400.0), stress-ng multi-core (23516.07), and PassMark CPU tests (23056.78). Memory throughput registers at 87.55 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 43.49 GB/sec for writes.

The qualitative trade-off of this configuration lies in its scale versus core efficiency. While individual clock speeds and older architectural IPC limit single-threaded processing, its density of 32 vCPUs and 128 GB of RAM provides cost-effective throughput for multi-threaded services. Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.7xlarge is suitable for enterprise application tiers, Redis caching servers, web application serving pools, and multi-threaded background build or compilation pipelines.
